correctness.rationale: At the actual pinned RESULT.md theorem and Theorem 4.6 of Lambropoulou–Lorenzi, each original braid letter contributes its usual Artin exponent ±1 and each bond contributes A_ij^p or a pure conjugate, whose braid exponent is 2p. Thus for any bonded braid word w with d_B bond letters, e(Φ_p(w))=e(Φ_0(w))+2p d_B(w); source defining relations are bond-homogeneous, so d_B is invariant. Since all bond images are pure, π(Φ_pβ)=π(Φ_0β); if the latter is identity, each closure has n oriented components and T=e/2 by Stoimenow §2.6 eq. (2.19). For vector λ on P_n, each bond contributes one positive generator class transported by a strand permutation through braid blocks, so slope b∈N^{n choose2}, Σb=d_B, and b=λ(Φ_1β)−λ(Φ_0β) is intrinsic. For d_B>0, distinct p give distinct total linking, hence distinct oriented closures. Negative p, threaded bonds, pure underlying words, d_B=0 excluded, and n=2 example β=b12 giving lk=p are consistent. This is an analytic all-word argument, no computational experiment or unjustified infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The submitted vector formula and infinite-distinct-closures conclusion are direct formal consequences of already published inputs: Lambropoulou–Lorenzi (arXiv:2609.35340v1, Theorem 4.6, 28 Sep 2026) specifies Φ_p on every generator, with each bond mapped to a pure conjugate of A_ij^p, and Stoimenow (2023, §2.6, eq. (2.19)) identifies pure-braid exponent sum with twice total linking, and the full linking vector with P_n abelianization. Consequently the braid exponent homomorphism gives e(Φ_p β)−e(Φ_0 β)=2p d_B(β) by immediate additivity, while the classical permutation action on H_1(P_n) gives the nonnegative pairwise slope vector. The manuscript does not state the particular corollary in those words, but its complete all-generator formula mathematically implies it with no new nonstandard lemma. This is stronger evidence of coverage than a failed text search or merely similar titles.
residual_risks: There may be unindexed literature explicitly printing the same corollary, but such access cannot reverse decisive direct coverage by verified stronger established statements.
The proof relies on the published Φ_p homomorphism and classical pure-braid abelianization; those general antecedent proofs were not independently reproved in full.
The usual pairwise linking vector depends on ordered oriented components; the total linking sum is invariant under permutation of components but not arbitrary independent orientation reversals.

value.rationale: The geometric context is natural and the consequence of pairwise non-isotopic closures is valid, but its entire content is an immediate textbook-level evaluation of the abelianization/exponent-sum character on a published generator-defined homomorphism. For every bond e(A_ij^p)=2p, so the supposedly new slope and infinite family follow without a new lemma, nontrivial boundary, classification or new invariant beyond standard pairwise linking. The submitted proof merely unwinds already-known formulas and renames the bond count; it does not fill a mathematical gap distinct from applying Theorem 4.6 and elementary pure-braid linking. Correctness and usefulness as a note do not meet the substantive independent-value standard.
